inlines.v: JUST'NESS, noun Accuracy; exactness; as the justness of proportions. 1. Conformity to truth; as the justness of a description or representation. 2. Justice; reasonableness; equity; as the justness of a cause or of a demand. [Justness is properly applied to things, and justice to persons; but the distinction is not always observed.]
